item.title: Putin reportedly suggests summit with Trump and Xi to decide fate of Ukraine
item.description: The report comes amid mounting tensions between Ukraine and the United States, its largest military backer.

item.title: France hit by worst unrest in years as attempts to rein in government spending meet citizen ire
item.description: France’s worst unrest in years saw thousands arrested, prompting President Macron to vow an “uncompromising” response ahead of a critical budget vote.

item.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
item.description: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.
